title: MAPS: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for POI Data Production Based on Crowdsourced Street-view Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2611.19807v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Point-of-interest (POI) databases support location-based services, yet urban changes quickly make their records stale and manual maintenance is costly. Crowdsourced street-view images provide timely visual evidence, but converting them into database actions requires separating multiple POIs and irrelevant text in each image, then resolving incomplete observations against ambiguous records. We study Street-view Image-based POI Data Production and propose MAPS, the first framework to integrate structured POI extraction with database maintenance from such imagery. MAPS contains two cascaded modules. SPICE progressively adapts a lightweight vision-language model to reconstruct and filter text, group entries belonging to the same POI, and classify their semantics and completeness. translated_title: MAPS：基于众包街景图像的多模态智能体POI数据生产框架
translated_abstract: 兴趣点（POI）数据库支撑着基于位置的服务，然而城市变化迅速导致其记录容易过时，而人工维护成本高昂。众包街景图像提供了及时的视觉证据，但将其转化为数据库操作需要分离每张图像中的多个POI和无关文本，进而针对模糊记录解决观测不完整的问题。我们研究了基于街景图像的POI数据生产任务，并提出了MAPS——首个将从此类图像中进行结构化POI提取与数据库维护相整合的框架。MAPS包含两个级联模块：SPICE渐进式地适配轻量级视觉-语言模型，以重建和过滤文本、对属于同一POI的条目进行分组，并对其语义与完整性进行分类；RIMA则检索候选记录，执行基于证据的POI匹配和属性级推理，并有选择地获取补充性的视觉、地理空间等信息（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出MAPS，首个基于众包街景图像的多模态智能体框架，通过级联的SPICE模块（POI提取与分类）和RIMA模块（证据驱动的记录匹配与数据库维护），实现POI数据库的自动化更新与维护。
en_tdlr: MAPS is the first multimodal agentic framework that integrates structured POI extraction (SPICE) with evidence-grounded database maintenance (RIMA) from crowdsourced street-view imagery, enabling automated and timely POI database updates.
